Synthetic 35 x 35 x 35 cm cube projections, generated by tests/render_motion_fixtures.py.
Camera: 640 x 480, focal length 500 pixels, centred principal point, no distortion.
The background is ../negative.jpg. The cube is analytically rendered with shaded faces.
scenes.json records Euler rotations and nearest-surface range, plus ideal contour points.
Browser checks use real best.onnx detection, colour contours, and OpenCV pose fitting.
These fixtures do not establish physical accuracy or performance on the user's phone.
